**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve include chains beyond eight levels**

When a valid chain contains nine MDX partials and each partial starts with the next include, the walker can advance only one level per pass (the exact mutation this loop is compensating for). This hard cap exits after resolving the eighth file, leaving the ninth `(!...!)` marker in the emitted MDX despite there being no include cycle; detect previously seen signatures or otherwise distinguish cycles instead of limiting valid nesting depth.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
